# Copilot instructions for era-mock-api-rest

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. It is the shared guide for every AI agent and contributor: overview, commands, structure, conventions and the critical rules (work from `dev`, PRs into `dev`, never commit on `main`/`dev`, never push or open PRs without approval, keep `docs/features.md` and `bruno/` in sync, Conventional Commits).

For questions about what the API exposes and who can access it, check [docs/features.md](../docs/features.md) first: it is the source of truth for the API contract.
